execution_owner: root coordinator, serial against owned disposable fixtures
source_changes: new test module only; no production source modified
fixture_scope: Actual capability-role pools and real disposable Redis; synthetic SQL setup and independent privileged observations; no providers

cases.name: admin_totp_mandatory_algorithm_window_and_account_fail_closed
cases.coverage: Missing/malformed/out-of-window TOTP, wrong email OTP, SHA1 enrollment, unenrolled credential, disabled Admin; no sessions issued or TOTP step consumed on invalid input

cases.name: admin_totp_concurrent_step_issues_one_session_and_replay_is_denied
cases.coverage: Two independent pending challenges, one SHA256 time-step, row-lock race; exactly one session, last step recorded once, fresh-challenge replay denied

cases.name: device_proof_real_redis_concurrent_replay_reserves_once
cases.coverage: 16 identical signed proofs race through real Redis NX; exactly one success,15 authorization failures, independent GET and boundedTTL

cases.name: bound_refresh_stolen_credential_cannot_revoke_or_cross_family
cases.coverage: Missing private-key proof, token binding mismatch, other installation/family, valid rotation, missing-key ancestor attack leaves family active, valid-key ancestor reuse revokes all descendants

cases.name: bound_refresh_concurrent_valid_proofs_preserve_reuse_revocation
cases.coverage: Two distinct valid proof JTIs race one refresh identity; exactly one rotation, loser detects ancestor reuse and revokes winner successor

cases.name: device_proof_dependency_loss_denies_before_refresh_mutation
cases.coverage: Real fixture-owned Redis AUTH connection denial; bounded503 and unchanged family rows; this is dependency rejection, not a full stopped-service recovery scenario

cases.name: device_proof_http_enforces_original_path_replay_and_logout
cases.coverage: Actual Axum profile200 with own Patient row; missing/wrong binding/replay401; proof-required logout, SQL revocation, nextJWT401; separate legacy unbound family remains valid

cases.name: admin_web_hmac_http_exact_body_and_real_redis_nonce_replay
cases.coverage: Actual middleware missing/forged/modifiedbody403,valid proof reaches credential401,replay403; nonce GET/TTL and no session issuance

limitations: Admin tests seed post-password challenges, so they verify mandatory emailOTP/TOTP completion and session issuance rather than password-provider delivery
Synthetic P256 proofs verify server protocol, not Android Keystore interoperability
No physical-device, live provider or production acceptance claim
